Left and right are mixed into every earbud.
Stereo: left and right play separately.
Mono turns on when headphones connect and off when they disconnect.
Ready: writes the system setting directly
Root found: it will ask for access on first use

Android does not let ordinary apps change the mono audio setting. Pick one way to allow it:

1. Shizuku (no computer, Android 11+): install the Shizuku app, start it with wireless debugging, then tap the button below to grant access. Shizuku has to be started again after each reboot.

2. Legacy build (computer once): install SingleBud-legacy.apk with
adb install --bypass-low-target-sdk-block SingleBud-legacy.apk

3. Root: used automatically when available.

Without any of these you can still switch mono audio by hand in Android's accessibility settings.
Tip: add the SingleBud tile to Quick Settings to switch with one tap.
